identity_lock.silhouette: Rounded navy beret, ash-blonde bob, compact navy A-line dress, small tan satchel and the single small rabbit charm remain identical to the approved front model.
identity_lock.proportions: Approximately four heads tall with both feet planted, fixed root scale and the same canvas margins as the canonical idle frame.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Muted blue-gray eyes, pale rounded face, fixed fringe and subdued cool ash-beige hair with narrow restrained highlights; only a downward gaze, tiny head tilt and mildly analytical expression may change.
identity_lock.costume: Cream collar, orange ribbon, the approved brass-button layout, lace hem, tan strap, satchel and rabbit charm stay structurally unchanged; the rabbit keeps its white body, orange bow and exact small scale.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished anime sprite with fine dark outlines and restrained warm cel shading; fixed orthographic camera and neutral light. The approved high-resolution idle frame is authoritative.

action_contract.intent: She notices the rabbit, lifts it from the satchel with her bag-side hand, gently strokes from cheek to ear root and crown before returning to the cheek, then places it back on the bag.
action_contract.first_key_pose: The rabbit rises from the satchel toward the upper waist in her bag-side hand while the other hand remains gripping the diagonal strap; her gaze follows it.
action_contract.peak_pose: She keeps the complete rabbit supported at upper-waist height while the free fingertips travel in a continuous cheek-to-ear-root-to-crown-to-cheek caress.
action_contract.locked_elements: Feet, root position, body scale, dress silhouette, hat, hair, facial identity, satchel position, rabbit size and overall camera remain fixed.
action_contract.allowed_motion: The bag-side arm lifts and lowers the rabbit; the strap-side arm leaves the strap for a four-pose caress across cheek, ear root and crown, then returns. Head and gaze follow the rabbit while feet and root remain fixed.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No detached or duplicated rabbit, enlarged plush, new prop, opened bag, missing strap, torso bend, stepping, adult proportions, scenery, shadow, text, camera move or costume redesign.

key_pose_sources.strategy: Every motion frame is a separate full-character image-generation call supplied with the canonical reference and its temporal neighbors. No frame uses cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing or algorithmic interpolation.

threshold_notes.min_alpha_coverage: The approved front silhouette is slim and approximately 453 pixels tall in the final 512 pixel cell.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: The rabbit moves upward inside the existing body silhouette while the character root, bag and dress remain fixed.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: Only the arms, gaze and small rabbit move; the character root must stay stationary.

post_process.generation: Frames 0 through 13 are separate full-character image-generation calls using the canonical anchor plus adjacent temporal references; the approved direct-drawn frame 0 is reused only as the intentional returned-idle endpoint at frame 14.
post_process.forbidden: No cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing or algorithmic interpolation.
post_process.background_removal: Each generated frame uses a flat #FF00FF source background, explicit two-channel magenta chroma removal, soft edge matte and despill.
post_process.final_downsample: Each complete redrawn character is uniformly normalized once into a fixed 512x512 cell, aligned by shoe center and the y=472 visible baseline.
